metadata.description:
[Youtube Description]


Expand Video Description for Track Listing, Download Links and more information! [Note: 720p recommended for best audio quality]

From Sonic Paradox comes this album: a complete collection of all the music from the Sega Master System and Game Gear versions of Sonic 2, redone as piano/electronic remixes and covers! This album was put together over the course of a year by Philip "Dr. Mack Foxx" Byard, John "EspioKaos" Weeks and Thomas "Recorderdude" Hart. We all hope you enjoy this compilation!

*This Album Can Be Downloaded for Free From the Following Sites*
[File Size = 62 MB, 21 tracks encoded as high-quality VBR MP3s]

SoundCloud http://soundcloud.com/drmackfoxx/sets...

MediaFire http://www.mediafire.com/download/1hs...

Or, you can now get this album in FLAC format from MediaFire, also for free! [234 MB]
http://www.mediafire.com/download/teo...

-Track List-
0:00 Title Screen [Game Gear] / Intro [Master System]
0:24 Zone Title Card
0:29 Under Ground Zone
3:42 Stage Clear!
3:49 Sky High Zone
5:38 Life Lost
5:46 Will You Continue?
6:07 Game Over
6:16 Aqua Lake Zone
9:44 Speed Shoes [Master System]
10:41 Green Hills Zone
13:08 Gimmick Mountain Zone
16:07 Invincibility
16:54 Scrambled Egg Zone
19:10 Boss Battle [Game Gear]
21:25 Bad Ending [Game Gear] / Staff Roll [Master System]
23:47 Chaos Emerald
23:53 Crystal Egg Zone
26:15 Boss Battle [Master System]
27:59 Good Ending [Game Gear]
30:20 The End
30:29 [Album Credits Roll] Chrome Gadget Zone Piano

MIDIs Composed By- EspioKaos & Dr. Mack Foxx
MIDI Debugging- Recorderdude
Arrangement- Dr. Mack Foxx
Album Art By- Sonic Remix
Video Version By- Dr. Mack Foxx & VizardJeffhog

Please see the ending credits at 30:29 for a complete list of staff and other information.

Check out Dr. Mack Foxx's channel for more music: http://www.youtube.com/user/DrMackFoxx

Check out Recorderdude's channel for more music and lot's of other projects: http://www.youtube.com/user/recorderdude
